desc:
🐴 Collect, ride and race magical horses! 🏆

🎁 OPEN CRATES – 500 horses from Common to SECRET (1 in 50,000!). 9 breeds, 6 sizes from Mini to Titan, glowing neon coats and ultra-rare designer horses.

🤠 RIDE INTO THE WILDS – a huge map: Green Meadows, Lava Lands, Sunset Canyon, Waterfall Valley and Frost Peaks. Lasso wild foals and race them home before the rope snaps! Mythic, Cosmic, Divine, Eternal and even a Wild Unicorn appear at events.

⛈️ WEATHER & HAZARDS – storms, tornadoes, volcano eruptions and blizzards. Survive a hit and your horse can get a glowing MUTATION!

🏁 RACE – your best horse races automatically and earns coins. Climb the Season leaderboard and win the Season Horse!

💞 CARE & BOND – pick apples, brush and ride to earn your horse's trust.

🏡 Upgrade your ranch, collect the journal and become a Legend of the Wilds!

👍 Like & favorite for luck events!
